text: Your whole day, in one app.
At dawn, your prayer times, wherever you are.
In the morning, your adhkar, ready to read and count.
On the go, beautiful recitation, and live Quran radio.
In the afternoon, keep your dhikr.
In the evening, explore hadith, and find the qibla, anywhere.
And at night, the adhkar before sleep.
Share an ayah to your status, in seconds.
Free, ad-free, and it works offline.
Search Zad Al-Muslim on Google Play.
